args.body: Advance CATALOGUE-INQUIRY-USABILITY under a valid lease. First compare the existing catalogue buyer-request-path source-check with the exact served capture from TASK-179570700202. Reuse an equivalent completed check if it covers these bytes and both languages. Otherwise use the queued director-live-link-inventory.json if it commits, verify the relevant wording against the original HTML, and write one bilingual copy-and-paste example that a prospect could form using only the visible instructions. Compare it with an attachment or URL example and identify any missing information the operator would need for scoping. Use actual documented intake limits and distinguish what a prospect can compose from what a mail client or the operator can deliver. Stage a narrow correction only for a reproducible gap. Read back committed evidence and close with a lesson under the actual lease. No test email or deployment.

description: The catalogue demo returned HTTP 200 with a recorded homepage hash. That gives us a concrete next step after repeated prospect research: test whether a migration agency can form an eligible inquiry from the English and French instructions on the page it actually receives. Feedback is available and has no classified commercial signals, but five sources remain unclassified and attribution is incomplete, so demand is unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The Stream Commerce send still depends on its existing exact-draft operator decision. The intake test can proceed independently and uses fictional inputs only. A reproducible intake gap would justify a staged correction subject to independent exact-digest review before deployment.
